messages:
nina: Quick question for design eyes: pool picker compact mode now shows pool health badges (latency, errors) inline. How do we avoid visual noise while keeping it scannable?
sam: Maybe hide the detailed badges behind a chevron hover or 'more' menu. Keep a single status dot + tooltip.
kevin: Ops wants the 1h p95 latency visible by default for pools with autoscale enabled. Suggest we show only latency and an info icon.
nina: If we drop errors, support will complain. Could we show latency by default and show errors as a small badge only when >1%?
docbot: Docs note: ‘Latency badge shows p95 over 1h; error badge shown >1% failures.’
sam: Accessibility note: the badge text needs to be accessible to screen readers; use visually-hidden text like 'Pool A latency: 230ms p95'.
kevin: Copy nits for compact mode: 'Healthy' vs 'Degraded' label 9	make sure color isn't the only signal. Add an icon and text.
nina: Good point. We'll include an icon, color, and text. Also add keyboard action to expand details.
sam: I sketched a mini-interaction where pressing Space on a focused pool toggles the inline detail row. Might be neat for keyboard users.
docbot: Added link to spec: https://internal/docs/pool-picker-compact
nina: Thanks. I'll prototype and ping for a short review.
